$description: Every text / mark / background pair the Scrim chrome uses, with its WCAG 2.x contrast ratio, in both themes, at the DEFAULT accent (orange) and agent (violet). Pairs marked themeContrast.test.ts are the ones the repo enforces; the rest were found by reading theme.css.
method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance on sRGB values resolved in headless Chrome (see tokens.json $extensions.scrim.resolvedWith). Translucent colours are composited over the stated background first.

floors.text: 4.5:1 (every chrome text is under 18 px, so all of it is "small text")
floors.mark: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text: dots, edges, rings, icons, the primary button shape)
floors.disabled: exempt from 1.4.3; reported with meets3 (the repo holds text-off to 3:1 on the panel)

tokenNames: fg / bg are theme.css token names without the --scrim- prefix; "a@b" is token a composited over token b; artboard = --scrim-artboard; primaryHover / primaryPressed / dangerFillHover / disabledField are the computed state colours in tokens.json.

dark: agent-mark on bg-4: 4.2:1 (needs 4.5) — agent-edited marker (11 px) on a selected layer row
text-off on bg-1: 3.99:1 (needs 4.5) — Code tab line numbers (.scrim-code-line__n): NOT disabled, so held to 4.5:1
accent-on-fill on primaryPressed: 4.38:1 (needs 4.5) — primary button label while pressed (brightness 0.84)
light: agent-mark on bg-4: 4.12:1 (needs 4.5) — agent-edited marker (11 px) on a selected layer row
text-off on bg-1: 3.19:1 (needs 4.5) — Code tab line numbers (.scrim-code-line__n): NOT disabled, so held to 4.5:1
text-1 on tooltip-bg: 1:1 (needs 4.5) — modifier pill (.scrim-mod-pill) sets color: text-1 on tooltip-bg
accent-fill on bg-0: 2.64:1 (needs 3) — canvas distance chip block on the canvas field
warning on warning-tint@bg-1: 4.49:1 (needs 4.5) — lint chip / group count on the warning wash over the panel
accent-on-fill on primaryPressed: 4.38:1 (needs 4.5) — primary button label while pressed (brightness 0.84)
